verdict.rationale: monday's developer docs describe programmatic agent management via API/webhooks (run agents 'from your own code, anywhere you need it', subscribe to events, granular API scopes) which supports automated, non-UI orchestration, but there is no explicit CI/CD example, CLI tool, or headless test-running documentation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guide, a CLI or SDK for scripted/headless invocation, and independent verification of automation reliability.
